rules.when: a simple, unambiguous chore: a small fix with a known cause, a documentation update, a rename, a config tweak

ops, browser or terminal automation: driving a browser or CLI against an external system, deploying, merging, running or checking jobs, anything where the work is operating tools rather than writing code
simple research: look something up, summarize a file or a repository area, answer a bounded factual question

in-depth research or technical planning of ordinary difficulty: deep dives, design documents, architecture notes, reviews, investigations with judgement calls, including work that involves reading images or screenshots
rules.why: the bulk of research and design goes here; escalate only per the astra rule

rules.when: coding or implementation of ordinary difficulty: features, bug fixes that need investigation, tests, scripts, refactors, anything beyond a trivial chore
rules.why: the bulk of implementation goes here; escalate only per the fable rule

rules.when: exceptionally difficult research or design: novel architecture, root-causing across several systems, problems where the approach itself is unclear, or a research/design task that has already failed or been retasked twice on sol
rules.why: escalation only: the commander must state in model_reason why sol is insufficient or cite the two failed attempts

rules.when: exceptionally difficult implementation: intricate concurrency, protocol or cross-cutting changes, or a coding task that has already failed or been retasked twice on opus
rules.why: escalation only: the commander must state in model_reason why opus is insufficient or cite the two failed attempts

fleet.charter: Work on the Fleet project itself at ~/development/fleet. Nothing unrelated to that project.

openclaw.charter: Work on the user's OpenClaw setup: the ~/development/openclaw repository, its skills, gateway and browser automation, and incidents or post-mortems under ~/.openclaw/workspace. Nothing unrelated to OpenClaw.
